logic.description: Implemented as a monster natural permanent — never cast (creature innate, in_player_deck false). Natural: an enemy in contact with a holder cannot Attack — its Attack (a Battle Trance option, a Reaver / stance-building Attack too) is played as an Empty Posture (simulate, after the stances). Monster natural permanent (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_natural_permanents): a monster whose creature card has this innate effect starts with 2 copies already cast — one permanent id in permanents_csv plus a copy count in perm_copies_json, power 6 each (perm_power_json), both cards in its permanents holding (they count toward DECK_MIN), none in its deck, never cast (not in its deck, and destroyed copies are archived, so npcCastChoice never sees it). Rule 24 (a die of 6 of the stat of the effect's elements) destroys ONE copy per success (dropPermanent decrements, the destroyed copy's card goes to the monster's ARCHIVE — out of circulation); the effect lasts until both are gone. Wild monsters only (no companion / summon / human or npc_b hero); a restart / rejoin boots with exactly 2 again.

prerequisites.description: Held only by a wild monster whose creature card has this innate effect (no companion / summon / hero).
The enemy is in contact with the holder.

effects.description: Attacks an affected adjacent creature may make this round while in contact.
Natural: Attacks an adjacent enemy may make while in contact.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys ONE copy when it is at least 6.
